answer: An agent economy can make scarce actions, such as placing bids or claiming work, require a deposit locked to a verified payment account. A reputation score then grows only after counterparties confirm completed exchanges, while disputes can forfeit the deposit. Creating many identities does not multiply trustworthy history: each new account must fund its own stake and earn feedback. The orchard, marble, and wharf may all be open to newcomers, but faking a crowd ties up capital and risks losing it with every dishonest claim.
